      <PMID>900000001</PMID>
      <Article>
        <Journal><Title>Journal of Invented Trials</Title>
          <JournalIssue><PubDate><Year>2019</Year></PubDate></JournalIssue>
        </Journal>
        <ArticleTitle>A randomised trial of drug X in condition Y</ArticleTitle>
        <Abstract><AbstractText>Forty patients with condition Y were given drug X for eight weeks. Symptoms improved in most of them.</AbstractText></Abstract>
        <AuthorList>
          <Author><LastName>One</LastName><Initials>A</Initials></Author>
        </AuthorList>
        <PublicationTypeList>
          <PublicationType>Randomized Controlled Trial</PublicationType>
        </PublicationTypeList>
      </Article>
    </MedlineCitation>
  </PubmedArticle>
  <PubmedArticle>
    <MedlineCitation>
      <PMID>900000002</PMID>
      <Article>
        <Journal><Title>Journal of Invented Reviews</Title>
          <JournalIssue><PubDate><Year>2020</Year></PubDate></JournalIssue>
        </Journal>
        <ArticleTitle>Drug X and condition Y: a narrative review</ArticleTitle>
        <Abstract><AbstractText>This review summarises what is known about drug X in condition Y. No new patients were studied.</AbstractText></Abstract>
        <AuthorList>
          <Author><LastName>Two</LastName><Initials>B</Initials></Author>
        </AuthorList>
        <PublicationTypeList>
          <PublicationType>Review</PublicationType>
        </PublicationTypeList>
      </Article>
    </MedlineCitation>
  </PubmedArticle>

    <MedlineCitation>
      <PMID>900000003</PMID>
      <Article>
        <Journal><Title>Journal of Invented Trials</Title>
          <JournalIssue><PubDate><Year>2021</Year></PubDate></JournalIssue>
        </Journal>
        <ArticleTitle>Adverse events of drug X in a small cohort</ArticleTitle>
        <Abstract><AbstractText>Twelve patients taking drug X were followed for adverse events. Two stopped treatment because of nausea.</AbstractText></Abstract>
        <AuthorList>
          <Author><LastName>Three</LastName><Initials>C</Initials></Author>
        </AuthorList>
        <PublicationTypeList>
          <PublicationType>Journal Article</PublicationType>
